## Architecture and claim checklist

- [ ] No higher-precedence document is violated.
- [ ] No implementation claim exceeds recorded evidence.
- [ ] The host checkpoint is not misrepresented as Z product certification.
- [ ] No silent sacrifice was introduced.
- [ ] Search index, manifest, status, folder tree, and checksums were updated when affected.
- [ ] Architecture changes include owner approval and the required document set.
- [ ] Implementation work stayed within the authorized phase.
- [ ] Baby, GitHub applications, credentials, and implementation receipts remain outside Z product artifacts and runtime authority.
- [ ] Preserved history and rollback state remain intact.
